prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Does this umbrella stand belong to the café next door?
spokenPromptZh: 這個傘架是隔壁咖啡館的嗎？

options.text: The café stops serving lunch at two.
options.zh: 咖啡館兩點停止供應午餐。
options.whyZh: 只回到咖啡館營業時間。

options.text: Yes, they put it out on rainy days.
options.zh: 是。他們下雨天會把它搬出來。
options.whyZh: 確認所有權並加上相關說明。

options.text: I walked here without an umbrella.
options.whyZh: 個人是否帶傘與架子的所有權無關。

explanationZh: 確認所有權並加上相關說明。
evidence: Does this umbrella stand belong to the café next door? / Yes, they put it out on rainy days.
